My least favorite was AI centered utopia. I don't believe that there's certain things that AI cannot replicate or understand. Primitivist utopia. I do believe technology is essential for the way a lot of us live today. I think evolution requires innovation. Moral commonwealth, I don't think it's smart to depend on everybody's individual morality.
